correctness.rationale: The exact recursive three-round EF signature reduces to third-point atomic extension diagrams. The quotient quadratic form has both square-value classes outside every span of two quotient vectors for n≥2; preimage-of-span local multiplication is controlled by dimension≤2 data. Four-dimensional plus/minus enumeration gives the same attainable complete pointed profile rows, verified by independent direct enumerators. Explicit rank-two/three sentences separate D8, Q8 and stabilized groups. The rank-four witness is equivalent to existence of a totally singular 2-plane, distinguishing two order-32 forms. Bounds apply to the stated relational language; finite experiments corroborate but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: A natural infinite family of nonabelian groups has just three possible bounded-depth logical theories despite unbounded size and two quadratic Arf signs at each order. The theorem establishes a sharp 32-element minimal representative and identifies a genuine rank-three/rank-four expressibility boundary for the first pair of indistinguishable opposite Arf signs. This is a structural finite-model-theoretic classification, not a restatement of isomorphism classification.
